findings.claim: Refreshed props silently rebind an old draft to a newer expected revision.
findings.trigger: Admin A edits revision R1; admin B changes the row to R2. A stale rejection refresh or neighboring pricing editor success refresh replaces the revision prop without replacing/reviewing the old draft. A deliberate next submit carries stale field values and R2, so SQL legitimately accepts and overwrites B.
findings.downstream_check: SQL target revision comparison remains enforced but cannot detect replacement of the draft's original revision with R2. Company echo state, controlled terms draft, and selected-ID keyed uncontrolled pricing inputs retain old fields.
findings.required_fix: Bind draft baseline ID/revision to the actual displayed/selected values, retain original expected facts through unrelated refreshes, show separately established current facts after stale rejection, and require explicit review/adoption before a fresh draft can use newer revision. Never clear or replace pending/unknown immutable attempts. Cover company/terms/pricing and neighboring editor refresh.
findings.contract: producer-contract.md stale facts and exact terms approval; current historical result vs independent current facts; P-AC4/P-AC6.

findings.required_fix: Use the existing canonical trim semantics for reviewed saved equivalence or reconcile only the matching committed draft after a successful current read; preserve genuinely unsaved edits and exact current unapproved approval requirements. Add meaningful save/approve whitespace regression.

Cover active and archived reads and both editors with an owned regression.

findings.claim: Authority-race requests are lazy RPC builders and never start before lock observation.
findings.trigger: Four company.save/work_role.update x disable/re_role tests assign writer=call(op), then wait(1), and revoker=manage(...), then wait(2). Supabase/PostgREST builders execute on .then/await, so lock barrier cannot observe either request before finally consumes them.
findings.downstream_check: Authenticated fixture observer forwards RPC builders unchanged; no eager call wrapper. Other Promise.all/then paths consume builders normally.
findings.required_fix: Start real executing promises before waiting for each blocker, retain actual lock barrier and current-authority/audit/receipt assertions, and make cleanup settle in-flight requests deterministically without serializing away the race. Required actual CI execution remains outstanding.
findings.contract: P-AC3 current authority through mutation/audit/receipt; P-I authority race verification.
